title: Grok Bot alternatives for different jobs and budgets
h1: which grok bot alternative fits the job?
description: Compare Grok Bot, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Poke and dusk bot on price, model choice, computer use and what you can take with you.
answer: **if you already pay for an ai, dusk bot lets you use it for personal jobs without another subscription.** openclaw suits people who want their assistant in existing chats. hermes can make its own skills. poke works like a text contact. keep grok bot if your bots need the same signed-in browser after you close your laptop.[^2][^9][^13][^15][^19][^21]
og_line: keep the parts of grok bot you use.

them: **your bots hand off work in one place.** they can coordinate in a group and use the same files and logins.[^1][^2]
**you move between devices all day.** grok bot has native mac, windows, linux, iphone and android apps. the cloud computer stays at work between them.[^3]
dusk: **you want a different ai for each job.** change a bot's model and keep its chats and memory.[^22]
**you already own the machine.** run personal jobs there for free. pay for hosting only if you need it.[^20][^21]

sections.h: when the shared computer earns its price
sections.md:
**keep grok bot if a handoff depends on the browser staying signed in.** each bot gets its own screen on the same cloud computer. one can pick up work using files another left there. the trade-off matters for private accounts too. separate bot names do not separate those logins.[^1][^2]

if the only job is a reminder in apple messages, poke can do that without a new desktop to learn.[^15][^18]

sections.h: when the weekly pool changes the decision
sections.md:
**a message count won't tell you how much grok bot you have left.** tool steps and tokens draw from a weekly pool shared with grok and cursor. usage limits fell in early november after elon musk said serving costs were too high for the revenue.[^5][^8]

if you need to choose the model doing that work, consider openclaw, hermes or dusk. read your provider's sign-in terms before choosing a connection.[^10][^14][^22]

sections.h: bring a grok bot into dusk
sections.md: **try the move while you still have the original.** settings → import → **Move from Grok Bot** previews the skills, routines and memories in a setup file your grok bot writes. follow the [move guide](/guides/move-from-grok-bot) before touching your cursor account. deleting grok bot as a service means deleting that account too.[^3]

method: **we compared what you can buy, operate and take with you.** we make dusk bot. the sources list carries the date for each outside product. a gap in a cell means the cited material did not settle that question. we did not time jobs or rank answer quality.

faq.q: which alternatives to grok bot can i host for free?
faq.a: **openclaw and hermes have free mit-licensed software.** dusk also runs on a computer or server you own for personal use. budget separately for any server you rent and any paid model you connect.[^9][^13][^20][^21]

faq.q: can i bring an api key to grok bot instead of switching?
faq.a: **grok bot does not accept your key.** it chooses the model and does not show which one handled a task. dusk and both self-hosted open-source options support model keys.[^3][^10][^14][^19]
